name: data-grid-sort-list
title: Data Grid Sort List
author: gridcn
description: Toolbar sort add-on for the gridcn data grid: a sort button + popover listing applied sorts as editable, aligned rows (column / direction / remove / drag handle), with add/clear-all and precedence reordering via @dnd-kit/react drag or ArrowUp/ArrowDown on the grip (array order in SortSpec[]). New user-facing strings live under labels.sort (see data-grid/labels.ts DataGridSortLabels). Zero core changes — purely additive.
